All four chains started from distinct H tuples, none equal to truth (start_manifest.json: none_equals_truth = true, distinct = true), every chain made its first accepted H change at sweep 1, and every chain had left its start and reached the same true H cell before the 10000-sweep burn-in ended.

caveats: PARTIALLY SUPPORTED, not fully supported. What is frozen and established is (i) that exact FFBS over (S,z) alone does NOT unlock structural movement, (ii) that the collapsed move reduces the cross-H log-likelihood barrier by a median of ~132 nats and raises cross-H acceptance from ~1e-14 to ~5e-2 to ~7e-2, and (iii) that the validated collapsed kernel does in fact traverse thousands of distinct H states where the FFBS-only kernel traverses one.
What is NOT yet established is that this translates into correct joint POSTERIOR recovery of (S, z, H) simultaneously. That is exactly what Condition C tests and Condition C is pending.
Stage 6E2's terminal verdict was FAIL / MULTIMODAL at the registered 150k maximum ('(S,z)-U structural locking'). That FAIL stands and must be reported as a FAIL.
The 6E2/7B2 evidence is on the Stage 6E2 trace corpus, not on the matched formal corpus.
